problem.title: Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation
problem.problemStatement: Evaluate the value of an arithmetic expression written in Reverse Polish Notation (postfix notation). The supported operators are: + - * / Division truncates toward zero.
problem.input: Integer n Array of n tokens.
problem.output: A single integer representing the evaluated value.
problem.constraints: 1 <= n <= 10^4 The expression is always valid.
